Thank you for sharing the need for bulk‑archive functionality in DataBridge Pro’s Data Ingestion module. I’ve logged this as a feature request and forwarded it to our product team for review.

If you have any additional details (e.g., specific use‑cases, desired UI flow) that could help us prioritize, feel free to let us know.

Best regards,
